required_control: Re-run byte-level core checkpoint before and after every extension stage.
Panel membership/order/hash must predate extension rg.
Never combine the extension BH family with the immutable 396 core tests.
Exclude rerun h2 Z<4 from primary rg without replacement.
Exclude rerun intercept>1.2 from primary rg and retain sensitivity status.
Inspect cross-trait intercepts and disclose overlap; do not equate LDSC adjustment with independent replication.
Retain exact phenotype definitions and distinguish medication/proxy traits from diagnoses.
Require pair-level direct/same-phenotype/same-direction/same-sleep-context audit.
Require non-overlapping participants and separately sourced summary statistics.
Do not call global rg evidence of a shared locus; retain a prespecified globally-null secondary local set.
Evaluate horizontal, vertical/mediated, shared-factor, and sample-overlap alternatives; run PLACO+ on genome-wide data only.
Report H0-H4, priors, sensitivity, and claim guards; colocalization is not causality.
Synthetic tests stay under synthetic or temporary paths and carry explicit markers.
Do not silently analyze a result-selected subset of the locked panel.
Require checksum-locked ancestry-matched LAVA/HDL-L references; do not fall back silently to a smaller panel.
Freeze the pair-by-locus family, LAVA local-h2 Bonferroni gate, and local-rg BH family before result access.
Lock the entire Tier A/B candidate family before source curation and preserve NO_INDEPENDENT_DATASET outcomes.
Freeze a deterministic nonzero simulation seed per selected pair and retain it in the manifest.
Require identical dense SNP order/alleles, checksum-locked signed LD, PSD/symmetry checks, RSS-LD s, and kriging outlier diagnostics.
Complete eQTL/sQTL/pQTL searches per locked locus and preserve evidence-backed NO_SUITABLE_DATASET rows.
Lock p1/p2/p12 and the full p12 sensitivity grid before result access; label prior robustness separately.
Require exact release/accession, local query/result snapshot, SHA-256, access date, license/terms, and primary citation for every supported evidence row.
Emit every required chain edge, mark unsupported edges MISSING, and forbid a complete causal narrative from annotation-only evidence.
